description: SQL from a question and a schema (CREATE TABLE statements or a JSON description of tables and columns), for postgres (default), mysql, sqlite or bigquery. The tables and columns used are checked against the schema; a query that does not match it is retried once, then refused. Writes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DDL) are refused unless allowWrite is true. The query is not run. Choose this tool for: Generate a read-only SQL query from a question and a schema. Close alternatives on this server: text_answer (Answers a question from the given text only); wikidata (Read Wikidata with a read-only SPARQL query). Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

allowWrite.description: Allow INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or DDL (default false)

schema.description: CREATE TABLE statements, or a JSON object of tables and column lists (max 20,000 characters)

name: sql_generate
title: Generate a read-only SQL query from a question and a schema
